source_findings: Type=simple may report systemctl start success before the service binary has successfully execve()'d; therefore command success is not even a sufficient process-start witness for that service type.
Type=exec strengthens process-start evidence by waiting until execve succeeds, but still does not establish application-level function or target-device correctness.
Type=notify gates manager startup completion on READY=1; READY=1 is a service-originated self-report and must remain below Frankenstein completion authority unless independently checked.
sd_notify attribution has explicit races for short-lived auxiliary senders; sd_notify_barrier can synchronize receipt of prior notifications in cases where attribution would otherwise race.

The systemd D-Bus model exposes manager-observed Unit ActiveState/SubState and service Result; service units also expose NRestarts, while Unit exposes InvocationID and the manager can resolve a unit by InvocationID.

These manager properties provide stronger lifecycle/provenance evidence than a shell command exit code, but they still do not prove peripheral, endpoint, perception, audio, browser or application semantics.
A restart/recovery proof needs a fresh invocation identity plus fresh external readback; carrying forward READY or active-state evidence from a previous invocation would be stale-evidence promotion.

thin_native_rules: Represent systemd user-manager/service lifecycle observations as derived host-bound evidence, never as a second state authority.
Bind each service witness to TargetEnvironmentIdentity/profile digest, user-manager scope/UID, unit name, InvocationID and observation time.
Record ActiveState, SubState, Result, ExecMainStatus when available, and NRestarts; treat restart growth as negative/rework signal rather than hiding it behind a final active state.
Treat READY=1 and watchdog heartbeats as service health signals only; they cannot satisfy REAL_READBACK_VERIFIED by themselves.

For RESTART_RECOVERY_VERIFIED require a deliberately induced restart/relogin/reboot-class transition appropriate to the component, a new InvocationID, stable manager state, and fresh external function readback bound to the new invocation.
Do not infer interactive desktop-session validity merely from a live systemd --user manager; keep login/session/XDG/D-Bus/PipeWire/portal identity as separate proof obligations.

counterhypothesis: systemd lifecycle properties may duplicate existing EffectJournal/telemetry and can create false confidence if promoted above their scope; active/running, READY=1 and watchdog success can coexist with application-level deadlock, wrong peripheral binding or wrong desktop session.
next_falsifier: Against the current WP-1202/T1 twin, construct a deterministic fixture where manager lifecycle evidence is green but the external function-readback witness is absent/wrong, and require CompletionGate to remain below REAL_READBACK_VERIFIED; separately verify a restart produces a different InvocationID and invalidates stale pre-restart readback.
architecture_delta: CANDIDATE_E2: add a thin HostServiceLifecycleWitness projection between TargetEnvironmentIdentity and external functional readback; do not import systemd libraries or grant completion from manager/service self-report alone.
